title: Necromancer's Summoning
description: A hooded necromancer in ornate black robes stands on a ruined stone platform, casting a spell with outstretched claws. A glowing blue spectral figure emerges from a swirling portal near a crumbling gothic tower struck by lightning under a stormy sky.
